page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p-redis.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 8 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The CPU includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports AVX-512 vector extensions and AES cryptography. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core, but does not include any local storage or GPU accelerators.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates average multi-core processing capabilities, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 7025.92 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4486.0. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1318.98 and a weak single-threaded gzip compression rate of 23.01 GB/sec. Memory performance is stable, with cached read bandwidth reaching 392.36 GB/sec and uncached write bandwidth at 38.0 GB/sec.

The instance is designed for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory distribution without local storage dependencies. It achieves a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and handles 6.81 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks, alongside a static web serving throughput of 6.64 GB/sec. These characteristics make it suitable for memory-bound caching layers, web serving, and database operations that rely on network-attached storage.
